dct_title_s: Nepal Flash Flood: Damage Assessment using Sentinel-1 Radar
dct_description_sm: This dataset provides a rapid damage screening assessment for the 26 August 2026 Nepal flash flood and debris-flow event using 10-m Sentinel-1 Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) data. A post-event radar acquisition acquired on 28 August 2026 was compared with a one-year pre-event Sentinel-1 baseline to identify unusually strong changes in radar backscatter. The resulting damage proxy was spatially averaged using a 50 m neighbourhood and restricted to a built-environment search domain (residential and non-residential) defined from pre-event Overture building footprints and a 30 m surrounding buffer. A conservative operational threshold (K50 absolute z-score ≥ 1.60) was used to identify high-confidence likely-damage/change areas. The resulting layer was visually reviewed at post-processing level to remove identified artefacts. Across the assessed area, approximately 245.13 ha of high-confidence change were identified within approximately 4755 ha of assessed built-environment domain across 58,557 ha of assessed AOI. Admin-3 summary statistics are provided for 16 municipalities intersecting the analysis area. The product is a likely-damage / unusual-change proxy and not proof of structural or building-level damage. It is intended to support rapid geographic prioritisation, complementary imagery review and field assessment.
